observations: The round-0 test gap is closed: TestARecreatedBucketForgetsTheOldBucketsRecords kills the mutant that removes the reset branch.

The one production change in round 1 (settle no longer checks claimFresh) is dead-code removal. settle runs only on records that schedule judged verdictAttempt at the same now. ReclaimSettlement also re-checks freshness against the durable record. On the real binary, the fresh-claim probe was reclaimed only once it went stale.
